name: 新宝島トーアの新天地開拓記-TOAisNEWLAND-
detailed_description:
Overview

TOA is NEW LAND is a survival visual novel in which a young man and the girl Toa are cast ashore on an uncharted island after a violent storm. With only scarce resources and fragmentary clues, they struggle to stay alive. Although both have lost their memories, they instinctively feel that the other is precious. Working together—sometimes clashing—they build a fragile life on the island. By twist of fate, the story branches toward hopeful escape, tragic demise, or even the decision to remain and pioneer a new world.

Story

Before departure they dreamed of the great open sea—
The youthful protagonist and Toa set sail on a grand voyage in search of new lands. A sudden tempest, however, leaves them ship-wrecked on an unknown island. Armed with faint memories and a few belongings, they must confront hunger, the elements, and lurking dangers. Will they repair a battered raft to flee, or carve out a new haven on the island itself? As their bond deepens and fragments of the past resurface, they battle toward a course of hope—yet unseen threats may steal their future at any moment. Can the pair survive and escape, or will an unexpected ending await? Your fortunes will shape their destiny.

Features

  • Survival × Romance
    Gather water and food, stoke fires, reinforce shelters, and watch a tender love story unfold at the same time.

  • Multi-Ending Narrative
    Several outcomes await—hopeful escape, heartbreaking tragedy, or life as island pioneers—each unlocked through hidden conditions and chance.

  • Mystery of Lost Memories
    Piece together why the duo were ship-wrecked and why their memories vanished, reclaiming the past as their bond grows.

  • Immersive Writing
    Approximately 100,000 words deliver detailed survival scenes and subtle shifts in each character’s emotions.

The fate of two castaways rests on your luck and ingenuity. Will despair swallow them, or will a new route be charted? Embark on this sweeping tale born upon a deserted shore!
